summary: Braskem S.A. filed a 6-K reporting that its subsidiary Braskem Idesa reached a consensual restructuring agreement with major stakeholders, including shareholders, noteholders, and a term loan lender. Braskem Idesa commenced prepackaged Chapter 11 proceedings in the Southern District of Texas, expected to complete in 60-90 days. Braskem will contribute US$476 million (approximately US$126 million already provided) and retain a majority stake. Senior debt will be reduced from ~US$2.5 billion to ~US$1.6 billion. Operations continue normally; the restructuring enables new funding and deleveraging. Watch for court confirmation and completion timing.
